note: No MCP tools in rustre-mcp wire_tools.rs target the rustre-arch-msp430 crate directly. The validator is a self-contained ground-truth check derived from TI SLAU144/SLAU208 spec; it does not call MCP. Comparison degenerates to running the validator only.

failed_functions.name: check_emulated
failed_functions.reason: Validator test case expects MOV R3,R3 (As=00) -> NOP, but per TI ISA MOV with src=R3,As=00 is the constant #0 (CG), so the validator's own CLR rule (checked first) fires and returns CLR. This is an inconsistency inside the validator's expected-value table, not a workspace defect. MSP430 actually encodes NOP as MOV R3,R3 only as a programming convention; semantically it equals CLR R3.
